summary: Map a project into evidenced behavior, ownership boundaries, and verification paths.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Objective, target project, and the area to investigate.

completion_checks: Relevant entry paths and ownership boundaries have evidence.
Known verification paths are distinguished from checks actually run.
Uncertainty and inaccessible areas are recorded.
failure_modes: Required project content is unavailable: blocked.
Contradictory evidence prevents locating the requested behavior: inconclusive.
